# pbs_sync_job (Data Source)

Reads information about an existing PBS sync job configuration.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The unique identifier for the sync job.

### Read-Only

- `comment` (String) A comment describing this sync job.
- `digest` (String) Opaque digest returned by PBS.
- `group_filter` (List of String) Filter backup groups to sync.
- `max_depth` (Number) Maximum depth for namespace traversal.
- `namespace` (String) Local namespace for synced backups.
- `remote` (String) The remote server name; null for local sync jobs (datastore to datastore on the same PBS).
- `remote_namespace` (String) The remote namespace.
- `remote_store` (String) The remote datastore name, or the local source datastore for local sync jobs.
- `remove_vanished` (Boolean) Remove backups vanished from remote.
- `schedule` (String) When the sync job runs.
- `store` (String) The target datastore name.
